predictions.articleTitle: Salamanca UDS vs Celta Vigo Prediction & Match Analysis: Can Rotated Celta Break Helmántico Block?
predictions.coreRecommendation: Draw / Away Win paired with Under 2.5 Goals captures Celta Vigo's class edge alongside the genuine risk of a 90-minute stalemate under heavy rotation.
possibilityAssessment: Celta Vigo possess superior individual quality through travelling veterans Iago Aspas, Ferran Jutglà, and Marcos Alonso against fourth-tier opposition (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Moderate)
Under 2.5 Total Goals aligns with the lambda_total 2.25 baseline, Celta's 0.83 goals-per-game La Liga output, and Asier Domínguez's injury absence (Confidence: Moderate, Value: High)
Level half-time followed by a late Celta breakthrough (Draw-Loss) reflects Salamanca's compact early home block tiring in the final 30 minutes (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Moderate)

bet_recommendations.match_highlight: Heavily rotated Celta face Salamanca's home surge in tight Copa clash.

spf.comment: Covers both a controlled 0:2 Celta Vigo away win and a 1:1 90-minute draw, because Celta's nine senior absences and 50.0% big-chance waste make a single call too exposed.

over_under.comment: Supported by the lambda_total 2.25 baseline (60.9% Poisson Under 2.5), Celta's recent one-goal-in-four-games drought, and Asier Domínguez's absence for Salamanca UDS.

score.comment: 0:2 reflects Celta's top-flight quality breaking down fourth-tier legs late, while 1:1 covers Salamanca exploiting an unfamiliar rotated visiting defense.

goals.comment: Two goals (26.7% Poisson) and one goal (23.7% Poisson) align directly with a low-margin knockout tie below 2.5 goals.

bqc.comment: Both scripts project a compact, level first half before either Celta's bench breaks the deadlock (Draw-Loss) or Salamanca hold out for 90 minutes (Draw-Draw).
